prompt:
Create one standalone photorealistic photograph for Povod, a personal gift website. Use refined warm lifestyle editorial photography: considered light and composition with relaxed believable interaction, never a glossy advertising pose. Three adult friends aged 27, 30, and 35 lean toward a small birthday cake at a home table, laughing just before the birthday woman blows out the candles. Their faces remain fully visible and distinct. Use a close lightly directed group composition, candlelight supported by soft ambient light, and ordinary tactile home details. Output a square 1:1 composition for a website gallery. Make the key expressions and interaction readable at thumbnail size, with breathing room around the subjects. All people are fictional and independently invented for this image; do not reproduce anyone from a reference. Give them ordinary everyday appearances, distinct faces, realistic skin pores, age-appropriate texture, and natural clothing folds. Use an understated contemporary Russian or European everyday context without national stereotypes. Use warm neutrals, paper cream, muted terracotta, and natural surrounding colours with believable exposure, without a heavy orange filter. References inform only photographic techniques and mood; create an original scene and composition. Keep faces, hands, and important gestures within the central 70 percent of the frame, with comfortable safe margins and anatomically correct fingers, limbs, eyes, and teeth. No readable text, letters, numbers, logos, branding, watermarks, captions, borders, collages, grids, or contact sheets. No plastic skin, exaggerated smiles, duplicated people, extra limbs, or distorted perspective.

Additional subject and framing requirements: Make the birthday woman a curly redhead with freckles and a soft round face; her female friend has a short straight dark bob and rectangular glasses, and the male friend is clean-shaven with very short sandy-blond hair and a long narrow face. Make them visibly distinct. Exact square 1:1 composition.
review: Reviewed full square image: curly red-haired birthday woman blowing toward candles, dark-bob friend with glasses at left and clean-shaven blond friend at right. Three distinct faces and visible hands look coherent; cake, candles and home setting clear, no text or logos.
